description: Cold grey plates with a warm red seam shut inside them. It gives nothing until you cut, and then it takes its share back.
lore: Buyers turn one to the light, hunting the gap where the red shows through. The crackers gave that habit up years ago — shut tight or on show, it is the same stone — and test with the fist instead: close it and wait for one warm line to come up against the palm, in a stone otherwise colder than the grass it came out of.

What it does begins half a breath after your first cut lands. Whatever you opened, some part of it comes back the other way and closes what it finds. Everyone who has felt it says the same two things in the same order: that it is a great deal of comfort, and that it is not a kindness. Nothing is being given. Something is being taken and divided.

[[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] wears one wired in behind his belt buckle on the far rounds, through country the [[monsters/saber_toothed_tiger|Duskfang]] still holds. Asked at the meadow fire what carrying it is like, he gave the question thought — which from Gunnar is a long answer already — and said: like being lent to. He did not say by whom.
